en.summary: At the game event "SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026", many indie titles that are attracting attention with their original ideas are on display. Among them, ``HellHold'em,'' a deck-building roguelike set in hell, is appealing to visitors with its unique worldview and robust system.

ja.title: 名画に記憶と生命を宿す：TGS2026「ロストアートミュージアム」プロデューサーインタビュー
ja.summary: ハッピーネットから発売されている『失われた美術館 ～悲鳴収集記録～』は、美術館や名画をテーマにしたアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーはロスト・アート・ミュージアムの世界に偶然侵入してしまった主人公のヴィンスとなり、「絵画の精霊」と呼ばれる絵画から生まれたキャラクターたちと出会うことになる。探索とコミュニケーションを通じて、彼らは徐々に失われた記憶を取り戻していきます。今年のTGS2026では『The Lost Art Museum』のプロローグを体験してきました。始める前は、これは有名な絵画の擬人化が主なセールス ポイントであるアドベンチャー ゲームになるだろうと考えていました。結局のところ、ゴッホの「ひまわり」、レオナルド ダ ヴィンチの「モナ リザ」、葛飾北斎の「神奈川沖浪裏」に至るまで、これらのすでによく知られている芸術作品がゲーム内で新しいキャラクターに変身し、プレイヤーの冒険の旅の一部になります。ゲームの操作は複雑ではありません。プレイヤーはシーン内のアイテムをクリックして調査し、Huiling に話しかけて関連する手がかりを尋ねるだけです。

Players will play the role of Vince, the protagonist who accidentally breaks into the world of the Lost Art Museum, and meet characters born from paintings known as "Painting Spirits". Through exploration and communication, they will gradually restore their lost memories. At this year’s TGS2026, I tried out the prologue of “The Lost Art Museum”. Before I started, I originally thought that this would be an adventure game with the personification of famous paintings as its main selling point - after all, from Van Gogh's "Sunflowers", Leonardo da Vinci's "Mona Lisa" to Katsushika Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa", these already well-known works of art will be transformed into new characters in the game and become part of the player's adventure journey. The operation of the game is not complicated. Players only need to click on the items in the scene to investigate, and then talk to Huiling and ask for relevant clues.

en.title: Why is the Strawberry Music Festival doing a game show?
en.summary: Queuing up to try out games, receive peripherals, and collect stamps for lottery draws. In this rectangular space of nearly 100 square meters, many "players" are just like attending an ordinary game exhibition, curiously looking for their favorite games. If it weren't for the live music and audience cheers that kept coming from the distance, it would be difficult for me to realize that this was just a part of this music festival, not a game show or comic show in a certain convention center. It's not unusual to have a musical performance during a game show. Because game concerts are already a relatively mature business form. But if on the other hand, holding a game exhibition in a music festival would feel a bit fresh - especially when the organizer is a "new face" in the game industry: Modern Sky and Strawberry Music Festival. At the Guangzhou Strawberry Music Festival that ended at the end of September, Game House, a subsidiary of Modern Sky, teamed up with Haoyu Kuaibao to set up a game exhibition area at the festival. en.title: Preview of "Shadow Blade Zero": A quite complete journey of exploration and combat
en.summary: On September 3, Chule participated in the closed offline trial session of "Shadow Blade Zero" at the invitation of Lingyoufang. The important thing about this demo is that the version available at the event is arguably not that different from the version that will be released soon. During the approximately 5 hours of trial play, we had a relatively complete experience of the story opening, plot CG, level design and boss battles, and even details such as controller feedback. The process covered the entire first chapter of the big map, hidden maps, hidden bosses, a small amount of the second chapter content and two later bosses. If the previous demos released sporadically by Lingyoufang still gave people a feeling of peeking into the background, this time the demos make people feel quite reassured about the overall quality of the game. In terms of exploration and combat experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" maintains a consistently high level; in particular, games in the past have shown less in terms of levels and development, and this time it also brought us the biggest surprise. There were a lot of people at the scene, but it was not noisy. Most people were talking to friends at a moderate volume, or chatting nearby or on the Yin Yang Liao channel in the game. Generally speaking, they were very relaxed and comfortable. Behind me was a cosplayer who cosplayed as an Inugami. At first he was taking photos with other people, but then he seemed a little tired. He sat down cross-legged, took off his hood and held it in his arms. His face was very red and there was sweat on his forehead. The weather in Guangzhou these days is indeed very hot. In a sense, this "heat" also connects my usual feelings about "Onmyoji": intimacy, warmth, and longevity. Players waiting for the show to start gathered under the stage. Suddenly, there was some small commotion among the players on the side of the stage: a girl seemed to be standing up to hand out homemade materials, and the entire scene immediately became lively.

items.title: 誰が自殺願望を持つかを予測するのは難しいので自らを銃で撃てないようにする方が簡単だという専門家の提言
items.summary: 銃社会のアメリカでは、自殺者の半数以上が銃器により自殺しています。自殺を減らす取り組みは世界各国で行われていますが、それでも自殺者を予測するのは大変困難で、アメリカでは銃を禁止する方がよっぽど効果的だと専門家が主張しています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 专家表示，很难预测谁会有自杀念头，因此更容易防止人们开枪自杀。
zh.summary: 在美国的枪支社会中，超过一半的自杀者是用枪支自杀的。世界各地正在开展减少自杀的努力，但预测自杀人数仍然非常困难，专家认为在美国禁枪会更有效。阅读更多...

en.title: Experts say it's difficult to predict who will have suicidal thoughts, so it's easier to prevent people from shooting themselves.
en.summary: In the gun society of America, more than half of suicides are committed with firearms. Efforts to reduce suicide are being carried out around the world, but it is still very difficult to predict the number of suicides, and experts argue that banning guns in the United States would be much more effective. read more...
